text:
elaine: Starting a short thread for 'Obsidian Console' tweaks. Goals: tighten code syntax contrast, pick a single chart hue, and fix small hover affordance on table rows. Screenshots uploaded.
chris: For code: prefer cool teal accents over blue. Blue conflicts with link color. Teal -> #25c0a8.
maria: Teal is fine but run contrast check vs code-bg. Current code-bg: #0b0d10.
elainE: typo: that's me, elaine. I'll run checks. Proposal snippet:
:root { --bg-900: #06070a; --panel-800: #0b0d10; --code-accent: #25c0a8; --link: #4aa3ff; --comment: #6f747b }
sam: Hover affordance nit: current row hover uses box-shadow which hurts paint on long lists. Prefer 1px inset border (rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) + slight background lift (rgba(255,255,255,0.02)).
chris: Charts: single-hue teal ramp for sequential data, and neutral gray labels. Avoid multi-hue ramps.
contrast-bot: running: obsidian-console/2109876543. Preliminary: comment token ratio 3.4:1 (FAIL). code-accent ratio 6.2:1 (PASS).
maria: If comments fail, try #80848a or make comments slightly bolder/italic to aid legibility. Also add semantic token names: --interactive, --muted, --notice.
elaine: Action: (1) I'll post contrast matrix + a small Loom, (2) chris to prototype chart hue ramp, (3) sam to update hover CSS proposal and perf note. Any objections?
sam: No objections. I'll avoid box-shadow in long lists and add the inset border pattern.
maria: I'll add a lint rule to flag comment tokens <4.5 ratio.
contrast-bot: queued: full matrix will post in thread when ready.
elaine: thanks all 680 will follow up with results soon.
